fusions.name: Forager's Return
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stings at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 nature damage. 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Cross-Pollination
fusions.desc: Fires a spore that deals 12 plant damage and gives the target Rot for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Laden Swarm
fusions.desc: Releases a swarm for 10 seconds that strikes enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second. Each kill you make while it is out restores 5 health.

fusions.name: Capped Cells
fusions.desc: Every hit you land puts a stack on that enemy, up to 5. At 5 they all burst at once, striking the enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
